name: fpr_optin_hold
display_name: FPR opt-in holds free memory at the gate
description: Feature contract: after EnableFpr=1 and a device restart the hold settles inside the floor/gate contract window - the observable effect of the feature being active. What is asserted is the counter window; negotiation and held-page ownership are outside this suite's scope.

test_steps.guest_run: $k='HKLM:\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Services\BALLOON\Parameters'; if (-not (Test-Path $k)) { New-Item $k -Force | Out-Null }; Set-ItemProperty -Path $k -Name EnableFpr -Value 1 -Type DWord; Write-Output 'PASS: EnableFpr=1 set'

test_steps.desc: Restart balloon device to negotiate the feature
Give the hold cycles time to settle at the gate (soft early-exit window; the verdict is the next step)
Verify available settled in the contract window

cleanup.desc: Restore the default (off) state for whatever runs next
cleanup.guest_run: $k='HKLM:\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Services\BALLOON\Parameters'; if (-not (Test-Path $k)) { New-Item $k -Force | Out-Null }; Set-ItemProperty -Path $k -Name EnableFpr -Value 0 -Type DWord; Write-Output 'cleanup: EnableFpr=0 set'

cleanup.desc: Restart the balloon device so the runtime state matches the registry
